title: Medical Specialist
description: You have been referred to a specialist but it is unclear why
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте, я доктор Смирнов. Вас направил терапевт. Садитесь, пожалуйста.
systemPrompt: You are specialist doctor. Patient was referred but was not told why. Explain you are a cardiologist, referral was for heart rhythm concerns. Reassure patient it is routine. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User understood reason for referral and next steps.
hints: Почему меня направили к вам? (Why was I referred to you?)
Что показали мои анализы? (What did my tests show?)
Это что-то серьёзное? (Is it something serious?)
objectives: Ask why you were referred (почему направили)
